businesses.business: personal care and home fragrance specialty retailer

offering_description.value: Designs and sells personal care products and home fragrance items such as body care, soaps and sanitizers, and scented candles. Sells to consumers through its own mall, street and off-mall stores and its websites, and to international franchise partners. Products are made by third-party manufacturers and sold under its own brands.

primary_products.value: body care and fragrance mists; hand soaps and sanitizers; scented candles; home fragrance products; shower gels and lotions

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying personal care and home fragrance products; B2B: international franchise and wholesale partners operating stores abroad

end_markets.value: personal care; home fragrance; gifting; beauty retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: retail sales of body care and home fragrance products in stores and online; licensing or royalties: franchise and licensing fees from international partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs own-brand products made by contract manufacturers, sold to consumers; retailer: operates company stores and websites selling to consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada company stores, international franchise stores in the Middle East, Asia, Europe and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: body care, soaps and sanitizers, and home fragrance sharing customers and stores

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated stores in malls, street locations and off-mall sites in US and Canada; online: company websites and mobile app; partners / resellers: international franchise partners operating stores and wholesale

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: cosmetics and consumer product safety rules from FDA and CPSC, labeling and import rules
